purpose: Measure the bounded local five-UE platform without extrapolating to production capacity.

topology.traffic_path_required: benchmark-client -> uesimtun0 using source-policy table 1000 (named rt_uesimtun0 inside the UE container) -> UERANSIM gNB -> GTP-U -> Open5GS UPF -> intended DNN benchmark-server
topology.forbidden_path: direct Kubernetes Pod-network traffic from a UE benchmark client to a DNN endpoint

controls.run_order: ascending UE level within each repetition

session_state_reset.method: Both DNN benchmark-server restarts followed by the platform dependency-ordered 5G session-chain restart so UPF policy tables resolve the current DNN Pod addresses
session_state_reset.purpose: Prevent stale PFCP, GTP-U, NGAP, address-pool, or iperf3 state from carrying between load levels or repetitions

procedure_metrics.registration: timestamp from Sending Initial Registration to Initial Registration is successful
procedure_metrics.pdu_session: timestamp from PDU Session Establishment Request to PDU Session establishment is successful
procedure_metrics.success_denominator: expected active UE Pods in that run

resource_metrics.source: Prometheus range queries aligned to each measurement window
